introduction: King Edward Medical University (KEMU), established in 1860 in Lahore, is Pakistan's oldest and most prestigious medical institution. Originally founded as Lahore Medical School and renamed in 1911, KEMU is renowned for producing highly skilled medical professionals and pioneering healthcare education in South Asia. KEMU offers 5 undergraduate programs, 29 postgraduate programs, and numerous diplomas across medical and allied health sciences.

mbbs.program_title: Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
mbbs.program_description: The MBBS program at KEMU is a comprehensive five-year undergraduate degree designed to produce highly skilled and compassionate medical professionals. The curriculum combines foundational medical sciences, clinical training, and ethical practices to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to address complex health challenges. The program emphasizes hands-on experience through its affiliation with renowned teaching hospitals, including Mayo Hospital.

doctor_physical_therapy.program_description: The Doctor of Physiotherapy (DPT) program at King Edward Medical University (KEMU) is a 5-year professional degree designed to prepare students for a career in physical therapy and rehabilitation sciences. It focuses on the evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of movement disorders and physical impairments. The program aims to develop skilled physiotherapists capable of addressing a wide range of musculoskeletal, neurological, and cardiopulmonary conditions through evidence-based practices.

nursing.program_description: The Post RN Bachelor of Science in Nursing (Post RN BSN) program at King Edward Medical University (KEMU) is a 3-year undergraduate degree designed for registered nurses (RNs) who wish to advance their careers in nursing education, clinical practice, and healthcare leadership. This program equips nurses with advanced theoretical knowledge, clinical skills, and professional competencies to meet the growing demands of the healthcare sector.

allied_vision_sciences.program_description: The Allied Vision Sciences program is designed to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to become proficient in various aspects of vision care. It focuses on understanding the anatomy, physiology, and disorders of the human eye, as well as training students in modern techniques for diagnosing, treating, and managing eye-related conditions. The program aims to produce professionals who are capable of working in both clinical and research settings, including hospitals, clinics, and vision care centers.

allied_health_sciences.program_description: The Allied Health Sciences program at King Edward Medical University (KEMU) trains students to support healthcare professionals in various medical fields. The program covers areas like medical laboratory sciences, physiotherapy, radiology, and healthcare management. Students gain both theoretical knowledge and practical skills through hands-on training in hospitals and medical facilities. Graduates are prepared for careers in hospitals, diagnostic labs, rehabilitation centers, and health management roles.

dental_surgery.program_description: The BDS program at KEMU is a comprehensive five-year undergraduate degree designed to produce skilled dental professionals. The curriculum covers all aspects of dental sciences including oral anatomy, pathology, surgery, and preventive dentistry. Students receive extensive clinical training in the university's dental hospital.
